title: Syncopation Rhythm
description: Schema-ready rhythm drill for off-beat entries and syncopation.
overview: Syncopation means a note starts where your ear may expect a rest or a weaker part of the beat.
goal: Learn to wait through rests and enter on off-beat timing.
instructions: Study the gray rest blocks before pressing Start.
Use Play Example until you can hear where the off-beat note lands.
Begin Rhythm only when you can anticipate the first played note.

challenges.label: Eighth, quarter, eighth, half
challenges.hint: This pattern begins immediately, then stretches the middle note across a full beat.

challenges.label: Off-beat quarter pattern
challenges.hint: The first half beat is silent. Wait through the rest, then play on the off-beat.
